newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan March bad-cheque ratio falls to 0.56 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan March bad-cheque ratio falls to 0.56 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's bad-cheque ratio fell to 0.56 percent in March, down from 0.60 percent in February, the central bank said in a statement on Friday.
The number of bad cheques accounted for 0.56 percent of the total cheques written in March, with a value representing 0.33 percent of the value of all cheques written, the bank said.
The monthly bad-cheque ratio hit a 10-year high of 0.80 percent in October 1995.
In annual term, 1995's 0.67 percent was also a 10-year peak, the highest since the ratio hit 0.75 percent in 1995.

The bank attributed the rising number of bad cheques in 1995 to the slow economy and Taiwan's slumping property and stock markets. But in recent months, the bad-cheque problems have eased gradually, it said.
